feedback: Keep the inclusion decision, EuroQol support, publication form, single Study, primary family, instrument roles, and principal results unchanged. Add a SourceConflict linked to s1 and pop1. Record that the Results opening paragraph reports nine personal care workers and five lifestyle coordinators, while Table 1 reports eight personal care workers and six lifestyle coordinators; both locations agree on 20 staff in total. Add a DIRECT_CURRENT_ACTIVITY MethodUse with function QUALITY_CONTROL for the reported assessment of data saturation through interviewer discussions after each interview. Remove the 8–60 minute range and 26-minute mean from td1.duration because these values cover the complete interview. Preserve them in a separate interview-session TaskDesign that applies to mu2 and mu3.

Keep the inclusion decision, EuroQol support, publication form, single Study, primary family, purpose, design, and main interpretation. Make these local repairs: (1) change the roles of sex and age group from STRATIFIER to EXPOSURE_OR_DETERMINANT because both are tested predictors in Tables 5 and 6; (2) replace the pooled disease and functional-impairment factors with separate factors for each analyzed condition, using its exact source label and yes/no levels; link f5 specifically to physical impairment; (3) replace the umbrella Life & Health—young people predictor InstrumentUse with exact uses for the self-rated-health item, parental occupational-status items, disease checklist, functional-impairment checklist, and stress and depression items; retain SOURCE_STUDY_ACTIVITY and PREDICTOR_MEASURE, and record the three-month recall for the two mental-distress items; (4) add source-reported derivation methods for BMI calculation and categorization, combination of parental occupational status, and the stated dichotomizations of EQ-5D-Y-3L problems, disease, impairment, stress, and depression; (5) add a principal disease finding: the listed common diseases generally had more problems and lower unadjusted VAS scores, epilepsy had the lowest disease-group mean VAS score of 65.4, and diabetes showed no dimension differences; link this finding to the disease factors and to int1; (6) clarify that sam5 is an exclusion only from VAS analyses, not from the 6574-person dimension analysis; do not add a derived sample count as a source-reported count; and (7) in f6, use 2014 as the result time and keep “past 3 months” as the depression-item recall period. These repairs do not change the main scientific meaning.

Make these local corrections: (1) Change Design d2 temporal_structure from VARIABLE_SOURCE_TIME to NOT_APPLICABLE. The review used a search end date, but variation in source dates was not an analytic input. (2) Remove Philippines from pop1 geographies because pop1 describes populations represented in included studies, and the Results state that no relevant Philippine studies were found. Alternatively, change the label and role to state that the list is the intended search scope. (3) Add iu7, QWB, to the instrument_use_ids of o2 and o3. The review searched all named measures for construct validity, test-retest reliability, and responsiveness, even though QWB evidence was found only for construct validity. (4) Replace bundled MethodUse mu5 with separate, exact method uses for hypothesis-congruence assessment of construct validity, ICC assessment with the 0.70 threshold, and SES assessment with the 0.20 threshold. Revise mu6, or add another method use, to preserve the exact synthesis rules: sufficient at 75% or more positive studies, inconsistent at 25–74%, and insufficient below 25%. (5) In f3, give exact denominators: 1363 construct-validity studies, 80 responsiveness studies, and 61 test-retest reliability studies. (6) Remove sw1–sw4 as SoftwareUse records. MEDLINE, EMBASE, PsycINFO, and PubMed are reported search data sources, not four separate software products. Keep them in du1 and mu1; OvidSP can remain as part of the exact search-platform description.
